en-US.description: Rons File Wrangler: File & Folder Renamer
en-US.longDescription:
Rons File Wrangler is a Windows application for renaming and organizing files, folders, and entire directory structures in bulk.

Files often accumulate from different sources and follow different naming conventions. Photos, music files, downloads, work documents, and archived projects can quickly become difficult to manage consistently. File Wrangler provides tools to rename and organize large collections of files and folders using reusable rules.

The application uses a flexible rule-based system that allows renaming operations to be built from simple components. Nineteen renaming rules are available and can be combined into reusable rule sets to handle anything from straightforward text replacements to more advanced file naming tasks. Rule sets can be saved and reused whenever the same operation needs to be performed again.

Files, folders, and subfolders can all be processed together. Rules can add, remove, replace, format, split, and transform file names in many different ways, making it easy to standardize naming conventions and organize large collections.

For photo and music collections, File Wrangler can use information stored in EXIF image tags and MP3 metadata to build meaningful and consistent file names automatically. This helps create well-structured libraries without the need for manual editing.

Before any changes are made, a live preview shows exactly how file names will appear. Conflict detection and validation checks help identify potential issues, while automatic filename correction can resolve common conflicts. If required, renaming operations can be rolled back, providing an additional level of confidence when working with important files.

Frequently used tasks can be saved as shortcuts for quick access, while command line support makes it possible to automate renaming jobs and integrate them into larger workflows.

Some people use File Wrangler to organize photo libraries or music collections. Others use it to standardize business documents, manage downloads, prepare project files, or maintain large archives. Whatever the task, Rons File Wrangler provides a flexible and reliable way to rename and organize files on Windows.
